female.sp: RAS-96 Anksha from Gundam Unicorn. Preserve canonical mint-green and dark gray aerodynamic armor, red chest accent, broad rounded flight-transformable shoulder housings, backpack stabilizers and the two long forearm-mounted beam rifles. The rifles are attached externally to forearms, not extra human arms. Slim human waist and readable human legs inside the armor; no generic Gundam V-fin. Normal human anatomy: one clearly visible adult human face, two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand. Keep recognizable shoulder armor. Keep the existing dark neutral studio background. Head ornaments should be compact and fully inside the frame, without tall spikes touching the top edge. Full body, feet and major equipment visible; keep camera close and preserve subject scale, do not pull camera back or expand margins. Fit long weapons diagonally or at an appropriate length within the frame. No text or readable markings. Subtle adult sensuality and integrated open armor, fully opaque intimate coverage.
